IncidentBot: ALERT: dedicated-pool/core-prod hitting capacity (GPU queue depth 420, p99 latency 3.2s) — page: @oncall. See https://console.redwood/internal/alerts/2054006789 :rotating_light:
Elena (oncall): I'm on it, grabbing metrics now.
Elena (oncall): GPUs at 98% util, autoscaler attempted 3 scaleups in last 5m and failed due to quota limit error.
Jared (infra): confirmed — cloud quota for G4X is at account limit. Autoscaler log shows `QuotaExceeded: Insufficient quota to create instance`.
Sana (platform): Is this only for core-prod dedicated pool or affecting others?
Elena (oncall): Only core-prod Dedicated. Other pools show normal headroom. Queue length spiking on core-prod router.
Priya (solutions): Which customers mapped to this pool? Any high-SLA tenants that need immediate notifications?
Elena (oncall): Top tenants: AcmeHealth, ChatFlow, and one enterprise POC. AcmeHealth is reporting errors via support.
Alicia (acct): I can message AcmeHealth to tell them we're mitigating, ETA ~10-15m.
Jared (infra): Two live mitigation options: 1) Manually enable burst capacity (temporary reserve) for core-prod if available; 2) Apply traffic shaping/rate limits per-tenant to shed low-priority jobs.
Sana (platform): Enabling burst is fastest. Risk: we'll overshoot committed capacity and may incur additional spend. Confirm budget ok?
Alicia (acct): Finance ok for short window, notify if >2 hours.
Miguel (night-oncall): If you enable burst, can we also increase autoscaler max so it doesn't stop at the old ceiling?
Elena (oncall): Good call. Plan: (A) enable burst capacity for core-prod, (B) bump autoscaler max_instances=200 -> 300, (C) apply soft per-customer rate limit for non-critical tenants to 60% of baseline, (D) monitor 1m and 5m p99.
Jared (infra): I can run the burst toggle. Command: ```rwdctl dedicated toggle-burst --pool core-prod --enable --reason "autoscale quota exceeded"```
Elena (oncall): I'll patch autoscaler: ```rwdctl dedicated scale-config set --pool core-prod --max-instances 300```
Priya (solutions): I'll draft a short message to AcmeHealth saying we've enabled temporary mitigation and post expected latency improvements.
Jared (infra): Running toggle now.
IncidentBot: ACTION: rwdctl invoked by Jared (infra) at 2054006895 — toggle-burst core-prod enable.
Jared (infra): Burst enabled, allocating reserved nodes. Cloud reports 40 new nodes booting.
Elena (oncall): Autoscaler max patched at 2054006920.
Sana (platform): Applying per-tenant rate limit policy for best-effort workloads: ```policy apply --pool core-prod --selector labels.priority!=high --qps 60%```
Elena (oncall): Metrics update: GPU util down to 72% in 90s, queue depth 45, p99 latency 780ms. Looks effective.
Priya (solutions): Sent AcmeHealth note: "We're seeing elevated traffic and enabled temporary capacity; latency should improve. Will follow up with postmortem"
Alicia (acct): AcmeHealth reply: "Thanks — please keep us posted."
Miguel (night-oncall): Great. I'm taking on-call for the next handoff at 23:00 UTC. If anything regresses, page me.
Elena (oncall): I'm going to monitor for 30m and then start rollback plan: if stable for 20m, reduce autoscaler max back to 200 and disable burst.
Jared (infra): Leaving a small safety window: I won't disable burst until we've been stable for 30m. I'll run `rwdctl dedicated toggle-burst --pool core-prod --disable` when cleared.
Sana (platform): Create a quick runbook note in incident doc: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/2054006789 — include commands used and cost impact estimate.
Elena (oncall): Cost note: estimated extra infra spend for this burst ~ $3.5k/hour. Filed to the incident doc.
Priya (solutions): Also add follow-up: request quota increase with cloud provider to avoid recurrence and schedule Dedicated pool capacity review.
Elena (oncall): OK we'll hold on-call monitoring. If p99 climbs >1.5s again, escalate and consider per-tenant throttles more aggressively.
IncidentBot: NOTE: handoff scheduled — @Miguel (night-oncall) starts at 2054008000.
Miguel (night-oncall): Ack, taking over monitoring. Leave a quick status: burst enabled, autoscaler max=300, per-tenant soft limits applied, p99=780ms, queue=45, top tenants being notified.
Elena (oncall): Thanks — handing off to Miguel. I'm switching to follow-up/postmortem write-up.
Miguel (night-oncall): I'll close once we disable burst and confirm stable for 30m.
Jared (infra): If anyone needs the command history: ```/var/logs/ops/commands/2054006789.log``` contains the exact invocations.
Elena (oncall): Postmortem action items already in the incident doc: add automated quota alert, add runbook step to fallback to regional read-only pool, and coordinate with finance for burst spend approval pre-emptively.
Priya (solutions): Marking customer comms follow-up for tomorrow.
Miguel (night-oncall): All set on my side. Ping me if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
